head: cefae4ec
scope: diagnosis for the contract of stage M3 of the oxygen authority: what the engine does today, with the room oxygen inventory on, when the heat it accepts is and is not backed by the oxygen its owner can debit. Nothing is implemented, nothing under sim/ is changed and no trace is corrected
